entities.summary: Maurizio Stecca is a retired Italian boxer, who won the Bantamweight Gold medal at the 1984 Summer Olympics and WBO Featherweight title at 1991. He is the younger brother of former super bantamweight world champion of boxing, Loris Stecca.
